title: Make tadu migrate keep prose between items and sections that hold no item
notes: Found 2026-11-18 migrating ~/p (format 1 TODO.md at d73013e) with d3c3907: section-intro prose survives, but 206 TODO.md lines are dropped silently: paragraphs between items (the parked-summary paragraphs under '## Parked: waiting on you', e.g. 'Money and subscriptions', 'Accounts only you can open'), sections with prose and no item ('## Mailbox pass, Cristian's accounts (2026-09-25)'), the file header blockquotes, and TODO_LOG.md prose such as '#### Routing table' tables and '### How this file was pruned'.

Smallest next step: report every dropped line in the dry run (count plus first lines), then attach mid-section prose to the preceding item's notes and keep item-less sections and log prose as a closed note task per section.

Follow-up 2026-11-19: nothing is dropped silently any more, but a TODO.md with loose lines is refused rather than kept; whether to keep them as untriaged tasks is the decision recorded in the task discovered from this one.
result: Already fixed by the session 17 merge (unplaced_refusal, log_runs, loose_text_task); no code change needed.
evidence: Repro of the reported cases (paragraph between items, item-less section, header blockquote, log tables and prose): tadu migrate refuses a TODO.md with loose lines and lists each one by line number; after moving them into items, migrate --write keeps header, section prose and item prose, and turns TODO_LOG.md prose blocks into closed tasks. Tests: tests/test_migrate_loses_nothing.py, test_legacy_report.py
